$comment: Which commit the binaries people are downloading were built from.
1.1.2 is tagged v1.1.2 (annotated) on this commit; scripts/ci/repo-truth.mjs checks that the commit is on the release branch and that the public repository carries it.
artifacts: PDFluent_1.1.2_mas.pkg (Mac App Store build 6; sha256 2ca3f135017b754b9925edfa54832a95b6053a4e58b322fe15ad86f3dea9a705; in review)
evidence: Tag v1.1.2 is on d408d094. The Windows MSI was built from d408d094; the macOS DMG and the Mac App Store package were built from a5280d76, an ancestor of d408d094. Between the two commits the app source is unchanged (git diff --stat a5280d76 d408d094 -- src src-tauri/src src-tauri/crates package.json is empty); the differences are the release scripts, the manifest merge and docs.
Quality run dev-macbook-m1pro-2026-10-27-macos-a5280d7: verdict PASS (S0-S3 PASS; S4 and S5 not applicable).

Quality run build-desktop-windows-2026-10-28-windows-d408d09: verdict PASS (S0-S3 PASS; S4 and S5 not applicable). It needed the suite fix in 541ce1a2: the app trims sessions.log at 2000 lines and the run's byte-offset baseline then lost the first line.

The macOS DMG is signed with Developer ID, notarized and stapled (Gatekeeper: Notarized Developer ID). A manual Save As to a new file on the signed, notarized DMG app wrote the file, qpdf --check found no errors and an independent pypdf read returned the typed value (GOV-001, #998).

CI: Quality run 40461603985 on a5280d76 passed quality:macos and journeys:macos (including the new sandboxed journeys J-A3, J-B1, J-B2 and J-13). Later runs on d408d094 were cut short: the macOS jobs were refused at runner setup by the storage guard (internal disk below 23 GB), and the Windows CI jobs had not run when the binaries were judged. The release suite reports above are the record of the binaries being judged, not those runs.
Not shipped with 1.1.2: an updater manifest (latest.json) for 1.1.2; the Microsoft Store update.
